dateline: Las Vegas, NV — BTS sweeps 52nd AMAs (Artist of the Year, Song of Summer, Best Male K-Pop Artist); ARIRANG World Tour Night 3 at Allegiant Stadium tonight (May 27)
heroHeadline: Day 4,731: BTS Sweeps 52nd AMAs with 3 Wins — Artist of the Year, 'SWIM' Song of Summer & Best Male K-Pop Artist; Night 3 at Allegiant Stadium Tonight
heroSubtitle: May 27, 2026 is Day 4,731 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. On May 25 (Memorial Day), BTS swept all three of their nominations at the 52nd American Music Awards at MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas — Artist of the Year (their second time winning that prize), Song of the Summer for 'SWIM', and Best Male K-Pop Artist — bringing their total AMA win count to 14, the most of any act in AMA history. The group opened the ceremony performing 'Hooligan' and presented SZA with Best Female R&B Artist. On May 26, 'SWIM' surpassed 500 million Spotify streams, becoming the first song released anywhere in the world in 2026 to reach that threshold; all 14 ARIRANG album tracks have now individually surpassed 100 million streams. Tonight (May 27) is ARIRANG World Tour Night 3 at Allegiant Stadium (65,000 capacity) — the post-AMA homecoming show — with Night 4 completing the Las Vegas residency on May 28 before the world tour's next international leg. A BTS × Oreo limited-edition hotteok-flavored collaboration goes on sale June 1 in 80+ countries.
